execution.raw_text:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.max_phase,
  md.first_approval
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE md.max_phase IN (3, 4)
ORDER BY
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.max_phase,
  md.first_approval
```
